definition_verbatim: C: the equity group's close on that trade date: 15:00 CT on a normal day; the early close on a shortened day (the frozen equity calendar's early-halt time).
P(C-30): the close of the bar ending at C-30 (the bar opening at C-31; 14:29 on a normal day).
P(prior C): the close of the bar ending at the previous equity trade date's C (the bar opening at that date's C-1; 14:59 on a normal day, the early close minus 1 minute on a shortened day).

Eligible date: a trade date of the window on which both bars exist and carry one instrument_id, and r_ROD != 0. A date failing any condition has no trade, is not eligible, and is counted by reason ("missing_signal_bar", "missing_prior_bar", "instrument_change", "zero_signal").
rows.trigger_event: every eligible equity trade date (r_ROD nonzero, both bars present, one instrument_id); fires at the close of the bar opening C-31 (14:29 CT on a normal day)
rows.decision_time_ct: 14:30 CT on a normal day (close of the bar opening 14:29 = C-30); on a shortened day C-30 of the early close. Inputs: that bar and the previous trade date's bar opening C-1 (14:59 CT normal)
rows.side_rule: Entry: market intent on the bar ending at C-30, in sign(r_ROD) (buy if r_ROD > 0, sell if < 0), one MNQ, filling at the next bar's open (C-30).
rows.side_kind_note: r_ROD spans the previous trade date's C (15:00 CT) to today's C-30, i.e. the overnight session plus the day session to 14:30 CT
rows.intraday_hold: entry fill at the open of the bar at C-30 (14:30 CT normal) to the exit fill at the open of the bar after the first present bar at or after C-2 (about 14:59 CT normal); about 29 minutes; flatten backstop F 15:08 CT normal
rows.exit_rule_verbatim: Exit: market intent on the first present bar at or after C-2 (opening at or after C-2; 14:58 on a normal day), filling at the next bar's open. The engine's forced flatten at F (15:08 CT on a normal day) and its D9.7 price-limit exit are backstops.
rows.shortened_day_rule_verbatim: the frozen engine's F on an early-close date is the early close minus Topstep's lead, 30 minutes for 2019-2025 (rules/sessions.py TOPSTEP_EARLY_CLOSE_LEAD, Rule H-1 derived rows for 2019-2023), so F = C-30, the entry fill time. The engine therefore refuses every shortened-day entry (engine_flatten_window)
rows.expected_events_per_year: every eligible equity trade date (about 252 a year less roll-date instrument changes). Reported counts: verdict window 2020-06-01..2024-02-29: 971 trade dates, 956 eligible (15 instrument_change), 893 trades (refused: 33 engine_flatten_window, 30 engine_roll_blackout). rows.module: h6_rod/signal.py (compute_facts, T2 schedule); clock h6_rod/clock.py; literals h6_rod/constants.py (T2_WARMUP_TRADE_DATES 60, T2_LOOKBACK_ELIGIBLE 60)
definition_verbatim: C, P(C-30), P(prior C), r_ROD and Eligible date exactly as in E20H6-T1 (prereg section 3).
T2: eligible dates where |r_ROD| exceeds the median of |r_ROD| over the previous 60 eligible trade dates (Rosa, J. Futures Markets 2022, the threshold form).
T2's threshold for date d: the median of |r_ROD| over the 60 most recent eligible dates before d (within the ranges of section 2); d is a T2 date iff |r_ROD(d)| > that median (strictly).

T2 warm-up: the 60 equity trade dates before 2020-06-01 (their r_ROD values may feed T2's median for verdict dates; nothing else). For a verdict date d, T2's threshold uses only eligible dates in [the 60th trade date before 2020-06-01, d). If fewer than 60 eligible dates lie there, d has no T2 threshold and no T2 trade (counted "t2_warmup").
rows.trigger_event: eligible date with |r_ROD| strictly above the median |r_ROD| of the 60 most recent eligible dates before it
rows.decision_time_ct: 14:30 CT on a normal day (close of the bar opening 14:29); C-30 of the early close on a shortened day; plus 60 prior eligible dates' r_ROD
rows.side_rule: Entry: market intent on the bar ending at C-30, in sign(r_ROD) (buy if r_ROD > 0, sell if < 0), one MNQ, filling at the next bar's open (C-30).
rows.side_kind_note: same signal as T1, filtered by magnitude
rows.intraday_hold: C-30 open fill to the fill after the first bar at or after C-2 (about 29 minutes); F 15:08 CT backstop
rows.exit_rule_verbatim: Exit: market intent on the first present bar at or after C-2 (opening at or after C-2; 14:58 on a normal day), filling at the next bar's open. The engine's forced flatten at F (15:08 CT on a normal day) and its D9.7 price-limit exit are backstops.
rows.expected_events_per_year: about half of eligible dates by construction (above a trailing median). signal_legs: SqueezeMetrics GEX (S&P 500 options gamma exposure, dollars; previous trade date's row)
definition_verbatim: C, P(C-30), P(prior C), r_ROD and Eligible date exactly as in E20H6-T1 (prereg section 3).
T3: eligible dates whose previous trade date's GEX is negative (Baltussen et al.: momentum present when NGE is negative).

T3 (if registered): d is a T3 date iff the GEX value in the row dated the previous equity trade date of d is negative (strictly). A previous trade date with no GEX row gives no T3 trade (counted "gex_missing"). The row for date x is published after the cash close of x (E.14's timing record: Last-Modified 16:57 CT on the row's date), before d's entry. The day after a futures-only holiday session (Memorial Day, Labor Day, MLK Day, Presidents' Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Thanksgiving, Good Friday) has no GEX row for its previous trade date, so it is "gex_missing"
rows.trigger_event: eligible date whose previous equity trade date's GEX row is strictly negative
rows.decision_time_ct: 14:30 CT on a normal day (close of the bar opening 14:29); GEX row of the previous trade date, published about 16:57 CT that date
rows.side_rule: Entry: market intent on the bar ending at C-30, in sign(r_ROD) (buy if r_ROD > 0, sell if < 0), one MNQ, filling at the next bar's open (C-30).
rows.side_kind_note: same signal as T1, conditioned on prior-day negative GEX
